sdk.errorMessage:
JRunnerEx requires .NET SDK 10.0.401 exactly (pinned in global.json). Ubuntu apt packages only provide 10.0.1xx SDKs.
From the repository root install it with:
  curl -fsSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh | bash /dev/stdin --jsonfile global.json --install-dir "$HOME/.dotnet"
Then add these lines to your shell startup file (for example ~/.bashrc) and open a new shell:
  export DOTNET_ROOT="$HOME/.dotnet"
  export PATH="$DOTNET_ROOT:$PATH"
See README.md (Native build and fixtures).
